name: shahbazdev19/webchanges-ai-connector-mcp
description: Connect WordPress to any MCP-compatible AI client so agents can manage content, blocks, media, SEO, forms, and site settings over the Model Context Protocol.
_comment: The vendor/ directory (Jetpack autoloader, MCP Adapter, PHP MCP Schema) is committed and bundled with releases. Do NOT run `composer install` / `composer update` against this file — it would clobber the pinned, Jetpack-autoloaded vendor tree the plugin ships with.
